svg.title: Language coverage of selected clusters
svg.desc: Archived NeurIPS-era analysis. Selected clusters contained 28.4 percent of Shell requests, 17.5 percent of Swift requests, and 2.1 percent of Python requests. Each row uses a different selected cluster.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 21px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,21%); stroke:none;

g.text: A cluster captured only part of each language

text.style: font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 13px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,21%); stroke:none;
